customer_photo_wearer_current.name: customer_photo_wearer_current
customer_photo_wearer_current.where: "app"."customer_photos"."retired_at" IS NULL AND "app"."customer_photos"."wearer_id" IS NOT NULL

customer_photo_shape.name: customer_photo_shape
customer_photo_shape.value: ("app"."customer_photos"."role"='avatar' AND "app"."customer_photos"."wearer_id" IS NULL) OR ("app"."customer_photos"."role" IN ('face','body') AND "app"."customer_photos"."wearer_id" IS NOT NULL)

customer_wearers_gender_check.name: customer_wearers_gender_check
customer_wearers_gender_check.value: ("app"."customer_wearers"."gender_kind"='unspecified' AND "app"."customer_wearers"."gender_description" IS NULL) OR ("app"."customer_wearers"."gender_kind"='self-described' AND "app"."customer_wearers"."gender_description" IS NOT NULL AND app.customer_text_valid("app"."customer_wearers"."gender_description",60,false))

customer_wearers_birthday_check.name: customer_wearers_birthday_check
customer_wearers_birthday_check.value: "app"."customer_wearers"."birthday" IS NULL OR ("app"."customer_wearers"."birthday" BETWEEN '0001-01-01'::date AND '9999-12-31'::date AND isfinite("app"."customer_wearers"."birthday"))

customers_phone_check.name: customers_phone_check
customers_phone_check.value: ("app"."customers"."phone_e164" IS NULL AND "app"."customers"."phone_display" IS NULL AND "app"."customers"."phone_country_code" IS NULL) OR ("app"."customers"."phone_e164" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."customers"."phone_display" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."customers"."phone_country_code" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."customers"."phone_e164" ~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$' AND "app"."customers"."phone_country_code" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$' AND app.customer_text_valid("app"."customers"."phone_display",64,false))

customers_country_check.name: customers_country_check
customers_country_check.value: ("app"."customers"."address_country_code" IS NULL OR "app"."customers"."address_country_code" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$') AND ("app"."customers"."tax_country_code" IS NULL OR "app"."customers"."tax_country_code" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$')

customers_address_country_check.name: customers_address_country_check
customers_address_country_check.value: "app"."customers"."address_country_code" IS NOT NULL OR ("app"."customers"."address_line1" IS NULL AND "app"."customers"."address_line2" IS NULL AND "app"."customers"."city" IS NULL AND "app"."customers"."region" IS NULL AND "app"."customers"."postal_code" IS NULL)

customers_gstin_check.name: customers_gstin_check
customers_gstin_check.value: "app"."customers"."gstin" IS NULL OR ("app"."customers"."tax_country_code" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."customers"."tax_country_code"='IN' AND "app"."customers"."gstin" ~ '^[0-9]{2}[A-Z]{5}[0-9]{4}[A-Z][1-9A-Z]Z[0-9A-Z]$')

domain_import_batch_shape.name: domain_import_batch_shape
domain_import_batch_shape.value: "app"."domain_import_batches"."family" IN ('customers','measurements') AND "app"."domain_import_batches"."state" IN ('preview','running','complete','cancelled') AND "app"."domain_import_batches"."revision">0 AND "app"."domain_import_batches"."row_count" BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND ("app"."domain_import_batches"."namespace" IS NULL OR app.customer_text_valid("app"."domain_import_batches"."namespace",100,false)) AND ("app"."domain_import_batches"."namespace" IS NULL)=("app"."domain_import_batches"."purged_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("app"."domain_import_batches"."lease_token" IS NULL)=("app"."domain_import_batches"."lease_until" IS NULL)

domain_import_budget_shape.name: domain_import_budget_shape
domain_import_budget_shape.value: "app"."domain_import_budgets"."previews" BETWEEN 0 AND 5 AND "app"."domain_import_budgets"."chunks" BETWEEN 0 AND 10 AND jsonb_typeof("app"."domain_import_budgets"."leases")='object'

domain_import_record_shape.name: domain_import_record_shape
domain_import_record_shape.value: "app"."domain_import_records"."ordinal" BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND "app"."domain_import_records"."revision">0 AND "app"."domain_import_records"."state" IN ('pending','in-progress','created','reused','already-imported','skipped','needs-review','failed','cancelled') AND jsonb_array_length("app"."domain_import_records"."rows") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND jsonb_array_length("app"."domain_import_records"."redundant_rows")<=200 AND ("app"."domain_import_records"."payload" IS NULL OR octet_length("app"."domain_import_records"."payload"::text)<=655360) AND ("app"."domain_import_records"."prepared" IS NULL OR octet_length("app"."domain_import_records"."prepared"::text)<=1048576) AND "app"."domain_import_records"."candidate_count">=0

domain_import_source_shape.name: domain_import_source_shape
domain_import_source_shape.value: "app"."domain_import_sources"."family" IN ('customers','measurements') AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."kind" IN ('customer','wearer','profile','version') AND app.customer_text_valid("app"."domain_import_sources"."namespace",100,false) AND app.customer_text_valid("app"."domain_import_sources"."source_id",100,false) AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."accepted_hash" ~ '^v1:[0-9a-f]{64}$' AND (("app"."domain_import_sources"."kind"='customer' AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."family"='customers' AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."wearer_id" IS NULL AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."profile_id" IS NULL AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."version_id" IS NULL) OR ("app"."domain_import_sources"."kind"='wearer' AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."family"='customers' AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."wearer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."profile_id" IS NULL AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."version_id" IS NULL AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."parent_source_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("app"."domain_import_sources"."kind"='profile' AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."family"='measurements' AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."wearer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."profile_id" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."version_id" IS NULL) OR ("app"."domain_import_sources"."kind"='version' AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."family"='measurements' AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."wearer_id" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."profile_id" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."version_id" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."source_sequence">0 AND "app"."domain_import_sources"."parent_source_id" IS NOT NULL))

garments_provenance_check.name: garments_provenance_check
garments_provenance_check.value: ("app"."garments"."origin"='custom' AND "app"."garments"."template_key" IS NULL) OR ("app"."garments"."origin"='standard' AND "app"."garments"."template_key" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."garments"."template_key" IN ('shirt','blouse','trouser'))

master_services_provenance_check.name: master_services_provenance_check
master_services_provenance_check.value: ("app"."master_services"."origin"='custom' AND "app"."master_services"."template_key" IS NULL) OR ("app"."master_services"."origin"='standard' AND "app"."master_services"."template_key" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."master_services"."template_key" IN ('new-stitching','alteration'))

measurement_card_selection_shape.name: measurement_card_selection_shape
measurement_card_selection_shape.value: "app"."measurement_card_selections"."position" BETWEEN 1 AND 10 AND jsonb_typeof("app"."measurement_card_selections"."field_ids")='array' AND jsonb_array_length("app"."measurement_card_selections"."field_ids") BETWEEN 1 AND 30 AND jsonb_typeof("app"."measurement_card_selections"."projection")='object' AND octet_length("app"."measurement_card_selections"."projection"::text)<=262144

measurement_card_shape.name: measurement_card_shape
measurement_card_shape.value: "app"."measurement_cards"."projection_version"=1 AND app.customer_text_valid("app"."measurement_cards"."wearer_label",120,false) AND "app"."measurement_cards"."revision">0 AND "app"."measurement_cards"."expires_at">"app"."measurement_cards"."created_at" AND "app"."measurement_cards"."expires_at"<="app"."measurement_cards"."created_at"+interval '30 days' AND (("app"."measurement_cards"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "app"."measurement_cards"."revoked_by" IS NULL AND "app"."measurement_cards"."revocation_reason" IS NULL AND "app"."measurement_cards"."revocation_operation_id" IS NULL) OR ("app"."measurement_cards"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."measurement_cards"."revoked_by" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."measurement_cards"."revocation_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."measurement_cards"."revocation_operation_id" IS NOT NULL AND app.customer_text_valid("app"."measurement_cards"."revocation_reason",1000,false)))

measurement_photo_reservation_state.name: measurement_photo_reservation_state
measurement_photo_reservation_state.value: ("app"."measurement_photo_reservations"."consumed_version_id" IS NULL)=("app"."measurement_photo_reservations"."consumption_operation_id" IS NULL) AND ("app"."measurement_photo_reservations"."consumed_version_id" IS NULL OR "app"."measurement_photo_reservations"."consumed_version_id"="app"."measurement_photo_reservations"."version_id") AND "app"."measurement_photo_reservations"."expected_revision">=0 AND "app"."measurement_photo_reservations"."expires_at">"app"."measurement_photo_reservations"."created_at" AND "app"."measurement_photo_reservations"."expires_at"<="app"."measurement_photo_reservations"."created_at"+interval '1 hour' AND jsonb_typeof("app"."measurement_photo_reservations"."schema_ref")='object'

measurement_profile_kind.name: measurement_profile_kind
measurement_profile_kind.value: ("app"."measurement_profiles"."kind"='body' AND "app"."measurement_profiles"."garment_id" IS NULL) OR ("app"."measurement_profiles"."kind"='garment' AND "app"."measurement_profiles"."garment_id" IS NOT NULL)

measurement_version_schema.name: measurement_version_schema
measurement_version_schema.value: ("app"."measurement_versions"."body_schema_version" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."measurement_versions"."garment_id" IS NULL AND "app"."measurement_versions"."garment_version_id" IS NULL) OR ("app"."measurement_versions"."body_schema_version" IS NULL AND "app"."measurement_versions"."garment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "app"."measurement_versions"."garment_version_id" IS NOT NULL)
